lastCompletedStory.title: Send exactly once and skip the verify/retry cycle when the idle gate times out

nextStoryContext: sendKeysVerified's timed-out path (waitForIdlePane returns true) now short-circuits: it calls the new sendOnceUnverified helper (send-keys once, stderr warning preserved, emit exactly one 'push-undelivered' event with reason 'pane-not-idle' and retriesExhausted: 1) and returns immediately, never entering the geometry-verify/backoff/retry loop. maxAttempts/retryBaseMs/retryMaxMs/jitterFraction/randomFn/sampleGeometryFn/visibleCaptureFn are all unused on that path now. The non-timeout (idle-on-first-check or idle-after-poll) path is completely unchanged: it still runs the full verify/retry loop and emits 'push-undelivered' with reason 'retries-exhausted' on exhaustion. sendKeysVerified itself was refactored (extraction, not logic change) to stay under Biome's noExcessiveLinesPerFunction(max=80) ceiling after the new branch pushed it over. One pre-existing test (test/dispatch.test.ts, 'discriminator reads through visibleCaptureFn...') had to have its capturePaneFn fixture adjusted (append a trailing idle-prompt line) because its content never satisfied isOrchPaneIdle and it was inadvertently relying on the OLD (now-removed) behavior of still running verify/retry after a real-clock idle-gate timeout; its actual assertions (discriminator ignoring capturePaneFn, 2 sends via genuine retry) are unchanged. File-size ceilings for src/tmux/dispatch.ts (606->667) and test/dispatch.test.ts (747->823) were raised in the same commit.
